generated.title: What Should You Do During an Earthquake? Drop, Cover, Hold On! | Earthquake Science for Kids
generated.description:
If the ground started shaking RIGHT NOW, would you know what to do? Stay calm and remember three words: DROP, COVER, HOLD ON! Drop to your hands and knees. Cover your head and neck, and get under a sturdy table if one is close. Hold on until the shaking stops. If you're indoors, stay inside instead of running outside while the ground is shaking.

Safety guidance follows USGS, Ready.gov and the Earthquake Country Alliance. Talk with a grown-up about your family's earthquake plan!

Part of the Earthquake Science for Kids series from Next Huge Quake.
